_note: Single source for every caption and alt text on the avatar council post. The page and drafts/avatar-council/tools/merge-draft.py (article.md) both read this file; the merge never writes it.

V1.caption: Left: my first version. The concept critic's first read: “a cloud of glass dice, not as someone.” Right: the round 6 face that shipped. Both are rendered by the app's own three.js code.

images.alt: First version: a translucent aqua and lavender ball of glass cubes with two dark eyes, a few cubes orbiting it, soft bloom.
Round 6: a voxel girl with purple hair, a pale porcelain face, large dark eyes, pink blush and a wide smile.

V2.caption: Round 1 to round 6, same camera. Scores under each are style · UX · concept, out of 10.

images.alt: Round 1, scored 4, 4.5 and 3.5: a purple voxel ball with a pale face patch crossed by an amber grid of seams.
Round 2, scored 5, 6.5 and 5: the amber grid mostly gone; the lower half of the face shades into lilac.
Round 3, scored 6, 7 and 6: a pale face framed by purple hair, a small braid on one side and a lighter band under the mouth.
Round 4, scored 7, 7.5 and 7: smoother hair cap and a rounder face with a simple smile.
Round 5, scored 7, 7.5 and 7: similar to round 4, with cleaner hair edges and blush.
Round 6, scored 7, 7.5 and 7.5: one head of hair with a side ponytail, large eyes, blush and a wide smile.

V3.caption: Council scores per round, out of 10. The dashed line marks my feedback after round 3; the solid line marks round 4, when the designer became three lanes and the render workbench was rebuilt.

V4.caption: The loop. Agents did the building, rendering and critiquing; I came in with feedback and made the ship call.

V6.caption: The same box and scale cut from the front idle render, round 3 and round 6, in color (top) and grayscale (bottom). The outlined band under her mouth in round 3 is the “shading beard”. The gray band is easiest to see in the grayscale row.

images.alt: Round 3 lower face in color: a slightly grayer band across the mouth row, outlined, and lilac shading at the jaw corners.
Round 6 lower face in color: even warm skin from the cheeks down to the chin.
Round 3 lower face in grayscale: the outlined band below the cheeks is visibly darker, like stubble.
Round 6 lower face in grayscale: the skin below the mouth stays one flat light tone.

V6b.caption: Round 6, idle. In the close-up, the hair cube under her chin and the lock tip at the jaw are real. At actual size I judged they don't read as stubble. The critics disagreed.

images.head: As the critics saw it
images.alt: Round 6 face in close-up. A small purple hair cube shows under the center of the chin, and a gray lock tip sits at her right jaw corner; both are circled.
